summary: Before admission you complete FEMGEN 101 or 103 and one more letter-graded FEMGEN course of at least 3 units; these do not count toward the honors units. You then take FEMGEN 199A and other workshop courses (FEMGEN 199B, 199C, 104X or 105) for at least 9 units. Your advisor checks the 3.5 GPA in FGSS coursework, the approved proposal and the honors thesis or creative project; transfer credit does not count.

gSPb9qkt.why: "students should have already completed FEMGEN 101 or FEMGEN 103, or a suitable substitute"; "students must also complete at least one additional FEMGEN course, taken for at least 3 units and a letter grade"; "open to students with a grade point average (GPA) of 3.5 or higher in Feminist, Gender, and Sexuality Studies coursework"; "A written proposal ... must be submitted to the FGSS program office for final approval." The preparatory courses "do not count towards the units required", so the workshop courses are left out of their pool.
